definitions.short: Uriel , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H222. Uriel אוּרִיאֵל proper name, masculine ( flame of El or my light is El , see אֵל below אלה ; compare Phoenician ארמלך in Assyrian Urumilki (Sen Taylor Cylind.ii.50 , compare COT 2Kin 18:13 )) 1 chief of Levitical line of Kohath, in time of David 1Chr 6:9 ; 15:5 , 11 . 2 maternal grandfather of Abijah 2Chr 13:2 .

occurrences.englishText: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.
of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;
David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,
He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
